findingJa: 1サムエル記25章はナバルの妻アビガイルを記し、27:3と30:5はその女性を改めて「ナバルの妻」と呼ぶ。2サムエル記17:25は別の文脈で、ナハシュの娘でゼルヤの姉妹、アマサの母とされるアビガイルを記す。固定本文は両者の同一性を述べない。人物索引persons_1に2SA Abigailの個別候補IDはなく、1SA人物プロフィールへ統合しない。確定同一性ではなく同名候補として保留する。
wikipediaAssessmentJa: 今回の2SA Abigail用候補プロフィールなし。ゼルヤ記事は17:25の姉妹関係を背景に扱うが、それだけでナバルの妻との同一性は立証されない。

primaryWitnesses.fixedWEBText: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.
David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.
David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.
David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
